title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 13 (Squamish River Valley)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Squamish River Valley
13 Those portions of M.U. 2-6 that are (a)within 400 m of the midline of any road highlighted in red on the attached map 'Closed Area 5.1-13/22', (b)within 800 m to the west and 400 m to the east of the midline of any road highlighted in orange on the attached map 'Closed Area 5.1-13/22', or (c)within 600 m of the midline of any road highlighted in purple on the attached map 'Closed Area 5.1-13/22'. [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2022, App. 3, s. 4.]
